svg.text: claudia — Insert ▸ Container (rendered text containers: LaTeX, Mermaid, Typst)
Screen designs for E12.5. The text is the truth; double-click edits it; clicking out draws it. Same menu, same editor, same states in creates, computes and composes.
A · The Insert menu (new; same in every app and shell)
File
Edit
Insert
Format
View
Tools
Config
Help
Container
(more entries later)
LaTeX
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F
Mermaid
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+G
Typst
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Y
Greyed out, with the reason, if the server cannot make the type.
Eight header-bar menus now (D120 had seven). Every entry has a key, as everywhere (D360, D361).
• Insert ▸ Container ▸ LaTeX puts an empty container of that type in the middle of what you see and opens it for typing.
• A text object selected? Nothing changes: containers are their own objects.
• Read-only viewers: the entries are disabled.
• Screen readers: menuitem labels are “LaTeX container”, “Mermaid container”, “Typst container”.
• Desktop shells: the same entries, from the one manifest (D361).
• Front page (no document): the Insert menu is not shown (D447).
B · One container, four states (creates)
The frame keeps its width; its height follows the picture's proportions once drawn.

g.text: A picture of the text. Selected: handles + type tag “LaTeX”.
LaTeX · Ctrl+Enter or click outside: draw · Esc: cancel
The source in a monospace field; Enter is a new line.
Last good picture kept in the document.
4 · Error (never colour alone: icon, words, line)
Also: tool missing → “Install typst…” with help topic.

svg.text: C · In a sheet (computes)
Anchored to a cell like images; moves with drag, never with row inserts.

g.text: Double-click edits in place, sized at least 360 × 200 so a diagram can be typed.
Name box / Go to can select it; Tab moves through objects; Enter or F2 edits it.
Description: made from the text (“Mermaid diagram: flowchart TD, Inputs → Model …”), editable,
or marked decorative. Tab order = reading order.
Recalculation never changes a container; undo goes back one text change.

svg.text: D · In a text (composes): the fence
A fence typed on its own lines becomes a container; the container floats over its paragraph (D179).

g.text: The energy of a system follows from
The energy of a system follows from
Types: ```latex ```mermaid ```typst (the name after the backticks is the type; an unknown name stays text).
Ctrl+Z after the conversion turns the container back into the three lines of text.
The container is dragged where it should sit; the words do not wrap around it yet.
Insert ▸ Container does the same without typing the fence.

svg.text: E · The rules every app follows
One component, one set of strings, one behaviour; only the place an object sits differs.
Keyboard
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F / M / T insert (page-owned, same in
every shell).
Enter or F2 on a selected container: edit. Esc:
cancel.
Ctrl+Enter, or clicking anywhere else: draw.
Tab leaves the editor only with Esc or Ctrl+Enter,
never by accident.
Screen reader / BITV
Editor is a labelled textarea: “LaTeX source of
the container”.
Drawing, done and error are announced (role=status
/ alert).
Alt text from the SVG title, else type and first
words; editable.
Focus returns to the container after drawing.
Collaboration
The text is one step per edit in the history
(“Edit LaTeX”).
A colleague editing it holds it: you see their
name, not a second editor.
Render results go to everyone; the picture is part
of the document.
Undo/redo follow the person, as everywhere (D395).
Missing tools
The menu entry is greyed when the server cannot
make the type.
Opened documents still show their last picture.
The message names the program and the help topic
render.configure-tools.
Nothing is installed from the page.
Office files: pictures go into odp/pptx (D394); in odt/docx/ods/xlsx a container is not written yet, and the export dialog says so (loss code “rendered-text”).
Not in this round: Excalidraw (owner's decision 2026-11-15), text wrap around containers, the source embedded in office files.
F · Editing details
What the person sees while typing; sizes are screen pixels at 100 %.

g.text: Typst · Ctrl+Enter or click outside: draw · Esc: cancel
Revenue grew by *12 %* over the plan.
Width follows the object (min 320), height grows with the text up to the slide/sheet edge.
Settings (only if the type has any)
Typst: page width [ 120 mm ] text size [ 11 pt ]
LaTeX: mode (•) formula ( ) text width [ 80 mm ]
Opened from the context menu: “Container settings…”
Copy a container: its text and settings travel as
Pasted into composes it becomes a container again.
Pasted into any other program it reads as text.

svg.text: Colours: iris (#6a5acd) = the app's accent for containers, as for selection; error uses icon + text + red, never red alone.
